findings.text: P1 The gate story set is not the walker story set: undecidedLightenings (src/finalise/light.js:208 to :217) lists every .json under rcf/user-stories/ recursively and merges criteria by id with the last listed file winning, while the walker loads only flat rcf/user-stories/*.json (src/core/store/loader.js:190 and :203). Reproduced on a scratch copy of 20ba87c: AC-1001-1 lightened from full to external in us-1001.json beside an unloaded copy of the base story at rcf/user-stories/zz/shadow.json; define validate exits 0 and the chain reads AC-1001-1 as external, yet build verdict review MERGE/PASS exits 0 with no decision and undecidedLightenings, the call light Finalise makes at light.js:298, returns empty. Found in the independent reading before the reproduction.

P1 The gate reads story blobs while the walker reads through symlinks: a story file replaced by a symlink to a lightened copy outside rcf/user-stories/ reads as no criteria at the gate (src/finalise/light.js:212 and :216, parse at :34 to :37) while the walker loads the lightened story. Reproduced on a scratch copy of 20ba87c: us-1001.json a symlink to ../../p16-us-1001.json carrying AC-1001-1 at external; define validate exits 0 and the chain reads AC-1001-1 as external, yet build verdict review MERGE/PASS exits 0 with no decision and undecidedLightenings returns empty. changedCriteria (light.js:165 to :178) shares the discovery, so the Finalise touched-set check misses the same files.

note, new criterion: P3 The blueprint refusal branch at src/blueprint/apply.js:253 to :256 sits in applyBlueprint, which only CN-058 and CN-096 claim, for criteria outside FBS-243, so test strength over AC-19905-1 to -34 never mutates it; the detection half is claimed by CN-1097 (replacementLightenings) and CN-1099 to CN-1101. No gate reads it.

note, new criterion: P3 replacementLightenings (src/blueprint/apply.js:548 to :555) swallows a read or parse failure of the owned story or the incoming file and skips that story, so the blueprint write-path guard fails open there; the review gate backs it.

note, new criterion: P3 The retry skip at src/core/store/writer.js:1544 matches the reason verbatim, so a retry whose reason differs only in surrounding whitespace adds a second resolved decision (over-records, never a silent lightening).

note, new criterion: P3 undecidedLightenings reads a story blob that does not parse as no criteria (src/finalise/light.js:216), so an unparseable base-side story turns each of its head criteria into a creation (fail open); not reachable while the base is validated main.
